name: revision-certificate
title: Document revision record
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM documents ORDER BY code

sections.title: Revision evidence
sections.sql: SELECT version,title,note,actor,created_at FROM revisions WHERE document_id=$1 ORDER BY version

sections.title: Current file fingerprints
sections.sql: SELECT f.name,f.sha256,f.byte_size FROM files f JOIN revisions r ON r.id=f.revision_id JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id AND d.current_version=r.version WHERE d.id=$1 ORDER BY f.name

name: review-request
title: Document review request draft
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM document_position WHERE status='active' AND (review_on IS NULL OR review_on<=current_date+7) ORDER BY code
